closing_note:
Completed vectorized Python/PyArrow streaming prototype on h2odb (slowest measured non-TPC synthetic generator from datagen-p0-baseline-measurements) under make heavy-run (host: macOS 27.0.1 arm64, 10 CPUs, 16 GiB RAM, Python 3.11.17, PyArrow 24.0.0, DuckDB 2.0.0; chunk_rows=250,000; per-chunk np.random.default_rng([seed, chunk_idx]); isolated /tmp work root deleted after run; zero tracked repo files modified).

Measured Results vs Legacy Baseline (h2odb):
- SF 1.0 (10,000,000 rows):
  * Legacy baseline: 120.62s .tbl gen (165.6 MiB RSS) + 5.56s Parquet conv (2,183.6 MiB RSS) = 126.18s total.
  * Vectorized Parquet: 6.20s (20.3x faster vs legacy gen+conv), 388.6 MiB peak RSS (5.6x lower than legacy conv), 576.4 MiB output.
  * Vectorized .tbl:    7.09s (17.0x faster vs legacy .tbl gen), 345.6 MiB peak RSS, 1,841.1 MiB output.
- SF 10.0 (100,000,000 rows):
  * Legacy baseline: timed out at 45s cap (extrapolated ~1,206s gen; Parquet conv OOM-capped > 8 GiB).
  * Vectorized Parquet: 62.14s, 395.8 MiB peak RSS (+7.2 MiB vs SF 1 — flat O(1) streaming memory), 5,762.3 MiB output.
  * Vectorized .tbl:    71.83s, 343.7 MiB peak RSS, 18,410.9 MiB output.

Determinism & Schema Fidelity:
- SF 0.01 repeated seeded runs: parquet_identical=True, tbl_identical=True (SHA-256 bit-identical).
- Arrow schema exact match against benchbox/core/h2odb/schema.py via ArrowTypeMapper (including DECIMAL(8,2) and DECIMAL(18,14) columns): schema_matches_target=True at SF 0.01, 1.0, and 10.0.

Verdict for datagen-p0-companion-adr:
- Vectorized Python/PyArrow clears SF 1 (~6s) and SF 10 (~62s, <400 MiB RSS) effortlessly on numeric/categorical synthetic workloads with zero new build toolchain or wheel matrix.
- Residual candidates that could still justify testing against budget in Phase 2 (and potentially triggering datagen-p2-rust-repo-gate only if vectorized Python misses budget) are string-heavy or multi-table FK-graph workloads (amplab 1,422.6 MiB gen RSS, joinorder_synthetic 3,133.1 MiB gen RSS, clickbench 105-column wide strings).

description:
## Problem
docs/internal/adr/adr-python-core-runtime.md places vectorized PyArrow/NumPy or embedded DuckDB SQL ahead of creating a native Rust package for non-TPC synthetic generators. We lack empirical evidence on how much throughput and memory reduction vectorized Python achieves on BenchBox's slowest synthetic generator.

## Change
- Select the single slowest or highest-RSS non-TPC synthetic generator identified in datagen-p0-baseline-measurements.
- Build an isolated prototype (in a scratch script or non-default branch) generating the same schema via vectorized NumPy/PyArrow or embedded DuckDB SQL with bounded-memory streaming output.
- Measure wall time (mono_time()), peak RSS, output bytes, schema fidelity against benchbox/core/<benchmark>/schema.py, and deterministic reproducibility at SF 1 and SF 10.

## Decision gates
- Quantifies the ceiling of vectorized Python so datagen-p0-companion-adr sets realistic per-benchmark budgets and an objective miss threshold for triggering datagen-p2-rust-repo-gate.
- Do not land prototype code into default generator paths; production migration happens in Phase 2 with per-benchmark versioning and Gate C acceptance.

## Guardrails
- Run SF 1 and SF 10 measurements exclusively under make heavy-run ([HEAVY-LOCK-001]).
- Write outputs only to an isolated temporary root and delete afterwards ([RUN-DATA-001]).
- Follow AGENTS.md worktree rules if any temporary branch is created; leave main clone untouched.
